subject.title: [Feature]: Full Workspace File Management API for Remote/Container Deployments

question: Should OpenClaw add a broad core `agents.workspace.*` read/write/delete/move API, and what scopes, limits, audit behavior, and destructive-operation UX must gate it?
rationale: The requested feature changes a Gateway security boundary and creates a durable public API; code inspection can show the gap, but cannot choose the permanent authorization and product contract.

options.title: Approve A Bounded Core API
options.body: Proceed with a rebased implementation only after maintainers settle namespace, scopes, traversal/file-size limits, symlink and hardlink behavior, audit logging, and destructive-operation UX.

options.title: Narrow To Read-Only Browsing First
options.body: Ship a smaller read-only workspace browser first and defer mutation, upload, delete, and backup semantics until the security model is clearer.

options.title: Decline Broad Core File Management
options.body: Keep workspace file management outside core unless a narrower plugin/API gap is identified and approved.

recommendation.title: Approve A Bounded Core API
recommendation.body: Proceed with a rebased implementation only after maintainers settle namespace, scopes, traversal/file-size limits, symlink and hardlink behavior, audit logging, and destructive-operation UX.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on Gateway protocol/API shape and security-sensitive core surface; steipete has recent merged ownership of the gateway protocol extraction and descriptor architecture.
